transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I... well, I guess I'm here because of my stomach. After I eat, I just... I keep making myself throw up. Sometimes I do it in the bathroom at the dry cleaners where I work, or right when I get home. I don't know. I just... I hate it, but it feels like the only way I can calm down sometimes.
Do you think you would still make yourself throw up if you didn't gain weight from eating?

I... I don't know. Probably not. It's just... if the scale goes up even a little bit, or... if my waistband feels tight under my work apron, I just panic. I feel like I've ruined everything, and... and like I'll be fat by the end of the day. So... yeah.
Do you often limit the amount or type of food you eat?
I... I don't really know. I guess I just try to be careful. I don't think I do anything special, just... normal stuff.
Have you had any big changes in your weight recently?
I... no. I don't think so. It mostly stays the same.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, like within an hour?

I... yeah, I guess so. Sometimes. When it happens, I... I can go through a lot. Like a full bag of chips, or... pastries from the corner store. Whatever leftovers are around. And sweet drinks. Just... all in one sitting. I don't even really notice how much is gone until... until I stop.
Do you exercise a lot?

I... yeah. I guess. On the days after I... eat like that. I just try to make up for it. I'll skip eating until late, or... I walk a lot. Even when my legs are already aching from standing at the cleaners all day. I just... have to keep moving.
Do you ever use laxatives or water pills to help with your weight?
No. I don't... I don't take anything like that. Just the walking.
How often do you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, like you described before?

I... I guess most weeks it happens... at least a couple of times. It's been going on for months now. I just... I eat way more than I meant to, and then I have to try and undo it. Like I said before, with the fasting, or the walking... or... sometimes I throw up. Just to... fix it.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?

I... I already said. It's... it's a couple of times a week. Most weeks. It's been like that for months. I just... I do whatever I have to do. The walking, or... or throwing up. Just... whatever it takes to undo it.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yes. I... I mean, if the scale goes up even a little bit... or if my pants feel tight under my apron at work... I just panic. I feel like... like I ruined everything. Like I'll just be fat by the end of the day.
Do you think you are overweight even when others tell you that you are not?

I... I don't really talk to other people about it. But... yeah. I mean... I can be doing good at the shop, just getting my work done... but if I catch my reflection in the glass somewhere... and my stomach or my hips look big to me... I just... I feel like a complete failure. It doesn't really matter what anyone else says.
Have you had any periods of time where you lost a significant amount of weight?
I... no. Not really. It mostly just... stays the same, I guess. Or goes up and down a few pounds. I've never really lost a lot at once. I'm just... trying to keep it from getting worse.
Do you usually make yourself throw up because you're trying to lose weight or because you feel uncomfortably full?

I guess... it's mostly because of the weight. I just... I eat, and then I have to get rid of it. I'll go into the bathroom at the dry cleaners, or... or as soon as I get back to my apartment. It's just... I have to do it. It feels like the only way I can stop panicking about what I just ate.
How many times a week do you usually eat a large amount of food in a short period of time?

I... I don't know exactly. Um... maybe a couple times? For months now, it's been... at least a couple times most weeks where I just eat way too much. And then... you know, I have to fix it. By throwing up, or just not eating the next day, or... or exercising a lot. Just... a couple times a week, usually.
Is making yourself throw up mostly to feel less full or mostly to not gain weight?

I think I... I mean, like I just said, it's mostly to not gain weight. I just... if the scale goes up even a tiny bit, or... or if my waistband feels tight under my work apron, I just panic. It feels like I've ruined everything. Like I'm just going to be fat by the end of the day if I don't do something. So... yeah. It's about the weight.
How many days in the past month have you eaten a large amount of food in a short period of time?

I don't know the exact number of days. Um... but when it happens, I just... I can go through a whole bag of chips, and some pastries from the corner store by my work, maybe whatever leftovers are in the fridge... and sweet drinks. Just all in one sitting. Usually before I even really notice how much is actually gone.
How many times a month do you make yourself throw up after eating?
I... I don't really keep track. It's just... I don't know. A lot, I guess. I haven't counted.
How many times a month do you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time?
I... I don't know that either. I just... I don't count the days. It just happens.
How many times a week do you usually eat an amount of food that you consider to be too much?

I guess... maybe a couple times a week. It's been like that for months. I just... I eat too much, and then I have to fix it. You know, throw up, or just not eat the next day, or try to work it off. Most weeks are like that.
